verdict: Organic presence is active but fading; paid channels remain dark this period.
narrative: Across all three locations — Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision — the last 28 days produced 399 combined Google Business Profile actions (directions, web clicks, and calls), with zero paid spend running on any channel. That organic foundation is now under pressure: GBP engagement dropped sharply in the most recent 7 days at every location, with Forte seeing a 64% decline, Advance Grinding 61%, and O'Hare Precision 68%, and all three recorded zero GBP activity over the final 4–6 days of the window. A web and SEO root-cause fix is in motion to address the visibility drop, and CRM and outreach work — some of which was due August 31 — is being escalated now to clear the blockers that are gating pipeline and email sequences. Next period you should see the SEO fix submitted, CRM stubs resolved, and outreach contacts pulled, which will re-open the downstream lead flow that is currently paused.
